Photo: Justin Casterline/Getty ImagesThe Big Dance is coming to Williams Arena this weekend.State of the brackets: The Gopher women's basketball team secured a No. 4 seed in the NCAA Tournament last night — which earned them the right to host first- and second-round games at home.When to watch: The Gophers will face 13th-seeded Green Bay at the Barn on Friday.A win earns them a date against either No. 5 Ole Miss or No. 12 Gonzaga.If you go: Tickets go on sale to the general public at 10am.Worth noting: Both University of St. Thomas basketball teams ultimately fell short of making the tournament in their first year of eligibility.email (opens in new window)sms (opens in new window)facebook (opens in new window)twitter (opens in new window)linkedin (opens in new window)bluesky (opens in new window)nextdoor (opens in new window)Add Axios on Google🌱Support local journalism by becoming a member.Learn moreMore Twin Cities storiesNewsMinnesota Senate primary heats up as ICE backlash boosts Flanagan among DFL delegatesMar 30, 2026Go deeper (3 min. read)Real EstateMinnesota real estate agent will trade property for Magic: The Gathering cardsMar 24, 2026Go deeper (<1 min. read)Food and DrinkKado No Mise chef is Minnesota's only James Beard finalistMar 31, 2026Go deeper (1 min. read)NewsMetro Transit ridership fell 3% last yearMar 11, 2026Go deeper (1 min. read)HealthHennepin Healthcare's crisis is a warning for safety net hospitalsMar 9, 2026Go deeper (2 min. read)More stories
